title: Derivative bound for the negative log complement
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $p_c,p$ are real numbers with $0<p_c<1$, $0<p<1$, and $p_c\le p$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ has value $1/2$ at $p_c$. Then the derivative at $p$ of the negative logarithm of one minus that polynomial is at least $1/(2p)$.
